# The case the record format exists for.
#
# `ack` is written and flushed BEFORE the command runs. So an `ack` with no `done` after
# it, and a connection that then closes, means exactly one thing: that call did not return.
#
# It is not recorded as returning 0. It is not recorded as returning anything.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|ack|1|hello
OBS|hello|1|3c5e7a91|call,resolve,read,report
OBS|part|3c5e7a91|target|console
OBS|part|3c5e7a91|firmware|13.520.001
OBS|part|3c5e7a91|probe|dev
OBS|done|1|ok||
CMD|2|resolve|libkernel|sceKernelStat
OBS|ack|2|resolve
OBS|sym|libkernel|sceKernelStat|present|shared
OBS|done|2|returned|0x80019c40|
# A null path. On at least one implementation this dereferences without checking.
CMD|3|call|0x80019c40|0x0|0x0
OBS|ack|3|call
# Nothing further arrived and the socket closed. The line below was written by the DRIVER,
# not by the probe - the probe was gone. The corpus marks it observed-by=driver, so a
# reader can tell a fact the system reported from one inferred from its silence.
OBS|done|3|died||connection closed after ack with no result
# The probe was restarted. A NEW session identifier is the signal: everything before this
# belongs to a different process, and nothing is resumed.
CMD|4|hello|1
OBS|ack|4|hello
OBS|hello|1|be22d047|call,resolve,read,report
OBS|part|be22d047|target|console
OBS|part|be22d047|firmware|13.520.001
OBS|part|be22d047|probe|dev
OBS|done|4|ok||
